positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Primarily developed in Golang across multiple projects, supporting legacy projects in Java. Infrastructure includes AWS, Kubernetes, Databricks, Splunk and Grafana.
• Currently working in the Customer and Identity and Access Management (CIAM) domain supporting integrations to support authentication/authorization for customer accounts across Zillow.
    - Led a cross-functional initiative spanning 7+ teams across frontend, backend, and mobile to deliver secure access for 22,000 private listings across the U.S.
    - Led the migration of account-service from legacy on-prem infrastructure to Kubernetes, reducing infrastructure costs by $10k/month.
    - Implemented step-up authentication to secure loan pre-approval workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Worked on Bridge Container, an internal platform team providing insights to customer data across Zillow.
    - Led integrations between Premier Agent, Zillow Home Loans, and the lead generation platform to
unify customer journey data and provide end-to-end visibility across customer teams.
    - Linked customer, loan, loan officer, and buyer/seller agent data, reducing friction for downstream customer data retrieval.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Primarily developed in Golang and PostgreSQL utilizing Kubernetes.
•  Lead the implementation of the workflow engine based on the CNCF serverless workflow specification.
    - The workflow engine is a self-service platform that allows other teams to build workflows
supporting retries and error handling.
    - Used to deploy assets on a per cycle basis and planned to be used to orchestrate
remediation actions and events hydration.
•  Led a team of three engineers to implement the back-end template rendering engine.
    - The rendering engine stores, renders, and serves assets across distributed services.
    - Used for rendering millions of emails per day and localization of dashboard components.
•  Implemented partition and schema generation logic within events archive.
    - Database tables are generated based on schema definitions and are supported by a monthly
partition generation.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Linux · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•  Primarily developed in Java, utilizing Camel, Ignite, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Maven, Jenkins and OpenShift.
•  Led the migration of offer savings aggregation from existing legacy systems to the new cloud platform.
    - Split monolithic service into a new separate Spring Boot microservice.
    - Created data channels for transferring existing and incoming from legacy and modern platforms.
    - Migrated over 200 million records and verified data was consistent.
    - Helped save hundreds of thousands of dollars in mainframe costs.
•  Led internal dashboard team to improve customer service representatives efficiency.
    - Supported newly built dashboard used for evaluating customer eligibility of offers and spending.
    - Worked with product and project managers to define the team's roadmap and gather requirements.
    - Coordinated integration with external teams to align on timelines and requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Jira · Linux · PostgreSQL · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Worked on the Flight Management System (FMS) Performance functionality.
• Contributed in the customization of the performance database feature by creating an early prototype of an auxiliary database. 
• Wrote Software Design Documents (SDD) describing low-level code design and requirements.
• Achieved Design for Six Sigma certification.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Primarily developed in C# utilizing Mono, WPF, SQL Server and SQLite databases.
• Implemented application to use georeferenced areas to enforce safety rules
• Implemented application to guide haul trucks to shovel loading locations.
• Projects involved communication between GPS receivers, Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI), Linux embedded systems, client-facing and central applications.
• Technical lead for above-mentioned projects. Presented project status to stakeholders and coordinated with other teams for cross-functionality development and testing.
• Lead testing efforts at the proving grounds to ensure product quality and robustness. Created and executed test cases for scenarios that could not be tested in the lab.
• Mentored junior developers through collaborative development, teaching best practices, and code reviews
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Linux · Microsoft SQL Server · C# · .NET Framework · T-SQL
